notes: Approved-state replay recipes for the SRC060 matched real-browser pilot (7 states x 3 viewports = 21 pair replays).
State names and viewports come from the accepted parity record src/03_sources/SRC060/evidence/parity/accepted-parity.json.
Every recipe is used UNCHANGED for both ORIGINAL and SPLIT; only the target entry URL differs per side.

Camera contract: CLUSTER_FOCUS reproduces the accepted cluster-1 pin via the deterministic natural focusCluster(1) fly end-state (reduced-motion 80ms fly; yaw/pitch default -0.18/0.10); node states reproduce the accepted node-0 pin through the source-owned __LT60_V12__.restore(snapshot) call with recipe DATA (no property-write script).
Screenshots request digest=canonical16 (byte-identical canonical pixel digest contract; raw PNG jitter from backdrop-filter blur is not the comparison channel).
Cross-track navigation (openActualTarget / Track 55/56/59 routes) is NEVER called; those remain SOURCE_NATIVE HOLD.
Recipes are DATA only: fixed module-owned readiness predicate, fixed assertions, no free-form JS.
